Study 1: Tend a changing garden one day at a time, choosing when to plant or prune.

TIMED INTERVENTION IN NONLINEAR CELLULAR GROWTH

A different way
to think.
The initial garden is fixed. Each day choose at most one cell to plant or prune, or wait; then Advance one day. Your total intervention budget is limited.
Growth happens simultaneously: a living cell survives with exactly one living neighbor; an empty cell grows only with two living neighbors. Left and right ends wrap. The rule table and next-day preview show every outcome.
Match the indexed final target after all days. Timing matters: Undo reverses a whole day, including its intervention and budget. Reset restores this study; Restart generates a new journey.

Tap a cell to select or cancel its intervention, then Advance one day. Tab and Enter / Space work on every control. Target and history identify every cell as live or empty.

No timer. A check explains what still needs attention. Undo and Reset study keep earlier studies; Restart begins all three again.

Causal Lab
Restart

Diagnose and repair changing causal networks

FIELD STUDY
Repair 1/3 · 10 battery · 3 spares · 3 audits

Two directed links have failed. Diagnose with measurements, then replace links to restore every acceptance test. There is no suspect list: compare your bench with the healthy wiring. A measurement costs 1 battery, or 2 when clamping a lamp off. Replacements change the machine immediately and use a spare, including healthy links.

Healthy wiring (each lamp is OR of its incoming live signals): A → C · B → C · A → D · C → E · D → E · B → F · E → F

Your instruments are ready.

Field guide
Two directed links fail in each network. Lamps use OR of incoming signals. Toggle A/B and optionally clamp C, D or E off; compare measured and healthy outputs.
Measurements cost one battery, or two with a clamp. Installing any replacement costs one of three spare links and changes subsequent measurements.
Restore all sixteen input/clamp acceptance conditions. Failed audits reveal a counterexample and spend a shared review credit. Repair three different topologies.

No timer. Every control works with touch or Tab + Enter / Space. Restart returns to a fresh expedition.
